- LANDMARK FRAME COVENT GARDEN generated the highest TW revenue of £3,766.40 across 12 orders with 340 units sold in 2011-W42.

- Six LANDMARK FRAME locations collectively accounted for 36.7% of TW revenue, with each location generating between £3,447.50 and £3,766.40 despite zero sales in LW and LY.

- GINGHAM HEART DECORATION surged 2054.1% WoW from £72.68 in LW to £1,565.58 in TW, driven by 2,130 units sold across 21 orders.

- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER declined 33.8% YoY from £4,843.45 in LY to £3,205.71 in TW, though it increased 17.5% WoW from £2,729.22 in LW.

- RED HARMONICA IN BOX achieved 26576.5% YoY growth from £3.75 in LY to £1,000.37 in TW with 830 units sold across 35 orders.

- PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS grew 72.3% YoY from £1,289.88 in LY to £2,222.96 in TW, though it declined 5.1% WoW from £2,342.01 in LW.

- CHOCOLATE HOT WATER BOTTLE increased 134.4% WoW from £680.33 in LW to £1,594.49 in TW, with units more than doubling from 126 to 330.

- ASSORTED COLOUR BIRD ORNAMENT fell 49.3% YoY from £2,609.84 in LY to £1,324.21 in TW, despite a strong 86.6% WoW increase from £709.80 in LW.
